'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghan peace process]]; [[Taliban insurgency]]; [[June 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
**The [[Ministry of Interior Affairs (Afghanistan)|Interior Ministry]] accuses the [[Taliban]] of killing or wounding more than 400 Afghan security forces personnel in the last week and said the [[insurgent]] group had increased attacks ahead of expected peace talks. He also accused them of attacking [[religious scholar]]s to put "psychological pressure" on the [[government of Afghanistan|government]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/06/14/Taliban-killed-wounded-over-400-Afghan-security-personnel-in-one-week-Govt.html (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present)]]
**The [[Ministry of National Defense (Turkey)|Turkish Defense Ministry]] says that [[Turkish Air Force|military jets]] successfully targeted [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|PKK militants]] in [[Sinjar]] and Qandil, [[Iraq]], among other places, as part of [[Operation Claw (2019)|Operation Claw]]. The ministry claimed it was in response to increased militant attacks on Turkish bases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-iraq/turkish-jets-strike-kurdish-militant-targets-in-northern-iraq-idUSKBN23L0UV?il=0 (Reuters)] 
*A drone strike in northwestern [[Syria]] kills two high-ranking members of the [[Guardians of Religion Organization]], linked to [[al-Qaeda]], according to opposition war monitors. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/06/14/Jordanian-and-Yemeni-al-Qaeda-commanders-killed-in-drone-strike-in-Syria-Report.html (AP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 19 people are killed and more than 172 injured Saturday after a [[liquefied gas]] tanker exploded on a [[China|Chinese]] highway near the city of [[Wenling]]. Close to 100 [[fire truck]]s responded. Some people are still missing. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2020/06/14/At-least-19-killed-170-injured-in-China-gas-tanker-explosion/1231592147112/?ts_=7 (UPI)]
